items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: the first time I played with Tom was with Brownlee's band

ctx.x: Where's Emil Gonzalez's family? Are they around, you know?

They did live on Gainia Street somewhere, out around, none say, around Constance Street, between Constance and Chapitulis. At Gainia? Yeah, in Gainia, G-A-I-N-I-E, Gainia, that's, that's just a couple of blocks up from, it's a little short street, it only runs to, it stops at Magazine Street, it runs from the river to Magazine Street. It's about the, about the 1200, about the 11 or 1200 block, coming up from Canal Street, and he may have one, because he had everything, he was a guy like Tom Brown, that collected…
Speaking of Tom Brown, when was the first time you heard him or his band?
